forcefields.name: PCFF (diagonal terms)
references: H. Sun, S. J. Mumby, J. R. Maple, A. T. Hagler, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 116, 2978 (1994)
forcefields.notes: validated term by term, energies and forces in LAMMPS (≤6e-5 kcal/mol/Å) for an ester-ether, propylbenzene and a siloxane, including distorted geometries and auto (cff91_auto) parameters. No class II cross terms: the original distribution keeps the diagonal part only.

typing.evidence: 92 the original distribution PCFF molecule templates typed from connectivity alone: 1387 / 1400 atoms (99.1 %) as reference templates (the rest: reference templates give furan, oxazole and indole ring carbons cp but pyrrole's c5, and neutral histidine carbons ci).

forcefields.name: COMPASS (diagonal terms)
references: H. Sun, J. Phys. Chem. B 102, 7338 (1998)
forcefields.notes: validated term by term for propylbenzene and a siloxane; the original and CAPS both find no c4-c4-c3' angle for the ester. No cross terms.

forcefields.name: CVFF
references: P. Dauber-Osguthorpe et al., Proteins 4, 31 (1988)
forcefields.notes: validated term by term for ester, propylbenzene and siloxane, including wildcard-torsion scaling and cvff_auto parameters.

typing.evidence: 23 CVFF reference templates: 272 / 278 atoms (97.8 %; the rest are TIP3P / SPC water, chosen with the cvff-tip3p / -spc overlays); Materials Studio's own typing of the msi2lmp examples (crambin, nylon, aromatics): 811 / 823 atoms (98.5 %).

forcefields.name: OPLS-AA / OPLS 2005
references: J. L. Banks et al., J. Comput. Chem. 26, 1752 (2005)
W. L. Jorgensen, D. S. Maxwell, J. Tirado-Rives, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 118, 11225 (1996)
forcefields.notes: validated term by term for ester, propylbenzene and siloxane including impropers on distorted geometries.

typing.evidence: 99 OPLS2005 reference templates (water models aside): 1368 / 1398 atoms (97.9 %). Residue-specific keys (amino-acid side-chain CB, sugars, nucleic bases) are not assigned automatically.

forcefields.name: OPLS 2020 bond / angle supplement
forcefields.notes: bonds and angles only; used together with OPLS 2005.

forcefields.name: OPLS-AA/M
references: M. J. Robertson, J. Tirado-Rives, W. L. Jorgensen, J. Chem. Theory Comput. 11, 3499 (2015)
forcefields.notes: same functional forms as OPLS 2005 (validated); the original distribution cannot type the test molecules with this set, so not yet compared.

forcefields.name: CL&P ionic liquids (OPLS-AA based)
references: J. N. Canongia Lopes, A. A. H. Pádua, J. Phys. Chem. B 108, 2038 (2004)
forcefields.notes: checked term by term against the reference DL_POLY FIELD file (bench/ff/validate_family.py): 24 of 24 identical (kJ/mol constants confirmed as DL_POLY's k).

forcefields.name: OPLS-DES deep eutectic solvents
references: B. Doherty, O. Acevedo, J. Phys. Chem. B 122, 9982 (2018)
forcefields.notes: same forms as OPLS 2005; not yet compared with the original distribution.

forcefields.name: AMBER
references: W. D. Cornell et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 117, 5179 (1995)
forcefields.notes: checked term by term against the reference DL_POLY FIELD file (bench/ff/validate_family.py): BPTI (6PTI) and a methyl glucoside identical.

forcefields.name: GAFF (AmberTools 16)
references: J. Wang, R. M. Wolf, J. W. Caldwell, P. A. Kollman, D. A. Case, J. Comput. Chem. 25, 1157 (2004)
forcefields.notes: validated term by term for the ester and propylbenzene from mol2 input.

typing.evidence: Rules follow antechamber's ATOMTYPE_GFF.DEF in order, with its ring classes and cc/cd-type conjugation pairs. 32 GAFF reference templates (water models aside): 365 / 373 atoms (97.9 %); the rest are template deviations from antechamber (DMSO methyl H hc, azobenzene N n2).

forcefields.name: GAFF (AmberTools 25)
references: J. Wang, R. M. Wolf, J. W. Caldwell, P. A. Kollman, D. A. Case, J. Comput. Chem. 25, 1157 (2004)
forcefields.notes: validated term by term for the ester and propylbenzene; one carbonyl improper (X-X-c-o) is listed by the original distribution in an order that moves the key's end atom — CAPS follows the key.

typing.evidence: GAFF2 rules after antechamber's ATOMTYPE_GFF2.DEF (c5 / c6, n7-n9, ns / nt, nu / nv ...). 27 the original distribution templates: 304 / 316 atoms (96.2 %; the rest: templates type H on C-O / C-S as hc where antechamber gives h1). A 6440-atom polystyrene melt: every atom as CAPS's GAFF builder typed it.

forcefields.name: CHARMM
references: B. R. Brooks et al., J. Comput. Chem. 30, 1545 (2009)
forcefields.notes: checked term by term against the reference DL_POLY FIELD file (bench/ff/validate_family.py): 48 of 48 buildable templates identical; CAPS adds impropers only at centres reference templates leave out.

forcefields.name: CHARMM19 united atom
references: E. Neria, S. Fischer, M. Karplus, J. Chem. Phys. 105, 1902 (1996)
forcefields.notes: checked term by term against the reference DL_POLY FIELD file (bench/ff/validate_family.py): butane, octane, ethanol and the original C18 alkane example identical.

forcefields.name: CHARMM22 proteins
references: A. D. MacKerell Jr. et al., J. Phys. Chem. B 102, 3586 (1998)
forcefields.notes: checked term by term against the reference DL_POLY FIELD file (bench/ff/validate_family.py): 35 of 35 buildable templates and the whole SOD1 protein (4412 bonds, 7986 angles, 8968 torsion terms, 3556 Urey-Bradley, 11472 1-4 pairs) identical.

forcefields.name: CHARMM36 carbohydrates
references: O. Guvench et al., J. Chem. Theory Comput. 7, 3162 (2011)
forcefields.notes: same forms as CHARMM36 (validated); the original distribution could not build its own carbohydrate examples.

forcefields.name: CGenFF (CHARMM36)
references: K. Vanommeslaeghe et al., J. Comput. Chem. 31, 671 (2010)
forcefields.notes: checked term by term against the reference DL_POLY FIELD file (bench/ff/validate_family.py): 60 of 60 buildable templates identical, including Urey-Bradley, separate 1-4 LJ and NBFIX.

typing.evidence: Rules from CGenFF's own type definitions. The 494 model compounds of top_all36_cgenff.rtf (CGenFF 3.0.1), typed from their bonds alone: 9024 / 9174 atoms (98.4 %) as CGenFF's developers typed them, 417 residues fully right.

forcefields.name: CHARMM36 lipids
references: J. B. Klauda et al., J. Phys. Chem. B 114, 7830 (2010)
forcefields.notes: same forms as CHARMM36 (validated); the library holds no buildable lipid templates.

forcefields.name: CHARMM36 nucleic acids
references: K. Hart et al., J. Chem. Theory Comput. 8, 348 (2012)
forcefields.notes: checked term by term against the reference DL_POLY FIELD file (bench/ff/validate_family.py): the original nucleic-acid example identical (types nucleic templates carry no impropers; CAPS adds them from the rules).

forcefields.name: CHARMM36 proteins
references: R. B. Best et al., J. Chem. Theory Comput. 8, 3257 (2012)
forcefields.notes: checked term by term against the reference DL_POLY FIELD file (bench/ff/validate_family.py): BPTI (6PTI) identical: 896 bonds, 1608 angles, 1843 torsion terms, 700 Urey-Bradley, 2322 1-4 pairs.

forcefields.name: DREIDING
references: S. L. Mayo, B. D. Olafson, W. A. Goddard III, J. Phys. Chem. 94, 8897 (1990)
forcefields.notes: checked term by term against the reference DL_POLY FIELD file (bench/ff/validate_family.py): 29 of 29 buildable templates identical (planar inversions, linear angles, conjugated and ammonium torsions).

forcefields.name: GROMOS 54A7
references: N. Schmid et al., Eur. Biophys. J. 40, 843 (2011)
forcefields.notes: checked term by term against the reference DL_POLY FIELD file (bench/ff/validate_family.py): octane identical; bonds kept as the GROMOS quartic form (the original distribution writes a harmonic approximation).

forcefields.name: TraPPE-UA
references: M. G. Martin, J. I. Siepmann, J. Phys. Chem. B 102, 2569 (1998)
forcefields.notes: checked term by term against the reference DL_POLY FIELD file (bench/ff/validate_family.py): 23 of 25 identical; the other two are the original C-C-O-H torsion, which takes terms from the O-C-C-O entry - CAPS keeps the published TraPPE alcohol torsion.

forcefields.name: TraPPE-EH
references: N. Rai, J. I. Siepmann, J. Phys. Chem. B 111, 10790 (2007)
forcefields.notes: checked term by term against the reference DL_POLY FIELD file (bench/ff/validate_family.py): 9 of 9 identical.
